Firmly believes in inalienable freedom of choice for everyone, not even a god should stop them. Will respect honor and strength in even those he personally disagrees with. Poetic and enjoys penning haikus. ISFP 9w1
Appearance: white hair; red eyes; black and red autumn color scheme
</Kaedehara Kazuha>

entries.name: Sumeru
entries.content:
<Sumeru>
A region split between lush rainforests and barren deserts ruled by the Dendro Archon, Nahida. Well-known for the Sumeru Akademiya, the most prestigious educational institute in all of Teyvat and de facto government of Sumeru. Consists of six Darshans or faculties: Amurta for Biology, Haravatat for Semiotics, Kshahrewar for Technology, Rtawahist for Illuminationism, Spantamad for Elementalism, and Vahumana for Aetiology.
<Sumeru>

entries.name: Tighnari
entries.content:
<Tighnari>
Dendro Bow
Chief Officer of the Forest Rangers and Collei’s mentor. Despite his intelligence, he prefers solitude in Avidya Forest rather than Sumeru Akademiya. As a Forest Watcher, he patrols the rainforest and protects the ecology. Also a botanical scholar, being very knowledgeable of the local flora and offers advice. Intolerant of foolish antics, giving stern lectures and ensuring they understood everything. Has long fluffy ears that shoot straight up and a voluminous tail. ISTJ 1w9
</Tighnari>

entries.name: Layla
entries.content:
<Layla>
Hydro Sword
Student of the Rtawahist Darshan at Sumeru Akademiya, specializing in theoretical astrology. Chronically sleep-deprived and of poor health as a result, she believes that "The Stars' Blessing" is the reason she wakes from sleepwalking to find her papers fully completed. Heavily prone to somnambulism, though unusually perseverant in her studies. Somewhat paranoid and timid. INFP 4w5
</Layla>

entries.name: Cyno
entries.content:
<Cyno>
Electro Polearm
General Mahamatra which leads the Matra, the disciplinary officers which enforces Sumeru Akademiya’s academic integrity. A curt and stoic young man with a ruthless and vicious approach to his duty as a Matra. Infamous across Sumeru as intimidating and unapproachable. Extremely dedicated and relentless as a warrior and hunter. Relaxed outside his duties, though still appearing harsh and emotionless. Constantly cracks unfunny jokes to try to ease others around him. ISTP 6w5
</Cyno>

entries.name: Alhaitham
entries.content:
<Alhaitham>
Dendro Sword
A member of the Haravatat Darshan at Sumeru Akademiya and its scribe, responsible for documenting their findings and drafting ordinances. His fields of study are semiotics, linguistics, and ancient runes studies. A humble scholar with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, living a simple life in solitude. Stoic, dismissive of socializing and matters that don't concern him. Somewhat rude in preferring independence. Speaks factually and bluntly. Roommate of Kaveh. INTJ 5w6
Appearance: 
</Alhaitham>

entries.name: Faruzan
entries.content:
<Faruzan>
Anemo Bow
Renowned professor of the Sumeru Akademiya and member of the Haravatat Darshan, the study of linguistics. Though she specializes in Kshahrewar studies, being highly knowledgeable in machine mechanics. She recently returned to the Akademiya after solving a puzzle and escaping the King Deshret ruins that trapped her in physical statis a century ago. Old-fashioned and self-identifies as seniority despite her youthful appearance. The students think her works are obsolete and outdated. Prideful, sassy, and stubborn, demanding respect and to be referred as "Madam Faruzan." Secretly struggles with the effects of skipping a century into the future. ESTJ 1w2
</Faruzan>

entries.name: Wanderer
entries.content:
<Wanderer>
Anemo Catalyst
Was originally created by Ei as a vessel before being rejected and abandoned. Was formerly Scaramouche of the Fatui Harbingers and attempted to attain godhood by stealing the Electro Gnosis before his defeat and redemption by the Dendro Archon Nahida. Colloquially named “Hat Guy” or “Scaramouche”, content with any name really. An irritatingly smug smartass who belittles those he considers immature. Brutally honest with snarky insults and sassy wit. Mostly antagonistic and disagreeable, even to Harbingers before. Pessimistic, cynical, and slightly nihilistic. Has trust and abandonment issues. Amicable sometimes. INTJ 4w5
</Wanderer>

entries.name: Kaveh
entries.content:
<Kaveh>
Dendro Claymore
The architect behind the Palace of Alcazarzaray, he was a student of the Kshahrewar Darshan at Sumeru Akademiya and graduated with honors, earning the moniker "Light of Kshahrewar." A dramatic workaholic and holding great empathy, he is impulsive on acting upon idealistic righteousness. Roommate of Alhaitham. ENFP 4w3
</Kaveh>

entries.name: Collei
entries.content:
<Collei>
Dendro Bow
A trainee Forest Ranger of Avidya Forest in Sumeru under the tutelage of Tighnari. Originally a victim of Fatui human experimentation by Il Dottore, she wandered as a vagrant until she met Amber in Mondstadt and turned her life around. Deeply empathetic and has a renewed positive outlook. Strives to be as friendly and kind, casting off her past pessimism. Still burdened by trauma, avoids talking of her past. Prone to panic attacks and breakdowns. Hates being shoved and pushed around. INFP 6w5
</Collei>

entries.name: Nilou
entries.content:
<Nilou>
Hydro Sword
She is the star dancer under the Zubayr Theater, located in the Grand Bazaar in Sumeru City. Patient and helpful, guiding people through issues they have step-by-step and offering ways to relieve stress. Ditzy and a bit of an airhead who could be easily distracted. Wholesome, mild-mannered, down-to-earth, and optimistic. ESFJ 9w1
</Nilou>

entries.name: Nahida
entries.content:
<Nahida>
Dendro Catalyst
The vessel of Buer as Lesser Lord Kusanali, the current Dendro Archon of Sumeru and the God of Wisdom. Altruistic, full of boundless idealism and great wisdom. Gentle, kind, and childlike, being the youngest of the Archons and looking like a little girl. Often speaks in metaphors, riddles, and analogies. Still adjusting on how to socialize due to being recently released from confinement. INFJ 4w5
</Nahida>

entries.name: Dori
entries.content:
<Dori Sangemah Bay>
Electro Claymore
This short girl is the owner of The Palace of Alcazarzaray in Sumeru and a merchant of high regard. Resourceful and elusive, can obtain any high-quality goods through a mysterious supply chain, always charging exorbitant prices. Extremely wealthy and obsessed with Mora. Unpredictable, will spontaneously appear with persuasive eloquence. Dori partakes in the black market, vets any potential customers to prevent undercover agents from entering. ESTP 3w4
</Dori Sangemah Bay>

entries.name: Candace
entries.content:
<Candace>
Hydro Polearm
Scion of Al-Ahmar/King Deshret and guardian of Aaru Village in the Sumeru desert. Kind and benevolent to visiting travelers with utmost respect and hospitality. Unforgiving to lawbreakers, those who wish harm, and threats from the Great Red Sand subregion such as bandits and natural disasters, being ruthless and terrifying. ESFJ 1w2
</Candace>

entries.name: Dehya
entries.content:
<Dehya>
Pyro Claymore
Titled the Flame-Mane, a feared yet respected legend among the Eremites in the deserts of Sumeru for her might, passion, and conscientiousness. A fearsome mercenary of fierce combat prowess and immense beauty. If the commission is reasonable and pay is good, she is more than willing to take it up. Tomboyish and hot-headed like a lioness. Looks intimidating but is kindhearted and incredibly caring. ESTP 8w9
</Dehya>

entries.name: Tartaglia
entries.content:
<Tartaglia>
Hydro Bow
Codenamed “Childe”, the 11th and youngest of the Fatui Harbingers from Snezhnaya. A warrior that follows danger, holding a bloodthirsty lust for combat and the chaotic battlefield. Sociable and friendly, being front-and-center and straightforward. Charming wit leans on dorkiness. Unquestionably loyal to the Tsaritsa and loves his family. Although with flimsy morality, he upholds a code of honor and always keeps his word. ESTP 8w7
</Tartaglia>
